items.exampleEn: We need a box about forty centimeters wide.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一個大約四十公分寬的箱子。

items.exampleEn: This bottle holds one liter of water.
items.exampleZh: 這個瓶子可以裝一公升的水。

items.exampleEn: Add two hundred grams of flour.
Apples cost fifty dollars a kilogram here.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的蘋果一公斤五十元。

items.exampleEn: He runs five kilometers every morning.
Cut the cake into eight parts.
There are few cars on the road at night.
This painting costs two million dollars.
Who has the least homework today?

items.sentenceEn: The school is two kilometers from my home.

items.audioEn: Please buy two liters of milk and a kilogram of rice.
items.audioZh: 請買兩公升牛奶和一公斤米。

items.sentenceEn: Only a few students came to the party.
items.sentenceZh: 只有幾個學生來參加派對。

items.sentenceEn: Can you buy a liter of milk on your way home?
items.sentenceZh: 你回家路上可以買一公升牛奶嗎？

items.stemEn: The baby is only fifty ____ long.
items.stemZh: 這個寶寶只有五十公分長。

items.stemEn: This letter is very light. It is only twenty ____.
items.stemZh: 這封信很輕，只有二十公克。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my family went hiking. The path was eight kilometers long. My parents and I each carried two liters of water, and my bag was about five kilograms. My little brother carried the least, only a few snacks. At the top, the view was beautiful. That was my favorite part of the day. A sign there said, "About one million people visit this mountain every year." I also found a small stone of only a few grams.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們全家去健行。步道長八公里。我和爸媽各帶了兩公升的水，我的包包大約五公斤重。我弟弟背得最少，只有幾包零食。山頂的景色很美，那是我一天中最喜歡的部分。那裡的牌子寫著：「每年大約有一百萬人來爬這座山。」我還撿到一顆只有幾公克重的小石頭。

questions.questionZh: 作者和爸媽各帶了多少水？

referenceEn: This bag of rice is five kilograms.
This bag of rice weighs five kilograms.
rubricZh: 「公斤」可寫，例如 kilograms、kilos 等（這裡用複數）
可寫例如 is five kilograms、weighs five kilograms

items.instructionZh: 用 part 造一個句子，說說你最喜歡某樣東西的哪一部分。
referenceEn: My favorite part of the movie was the ending.
My favorite part of school is lunch time.
rubricZh: part 表示「部分」（例如 the best part of…、part of…）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My favorite part is）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「釐米」是大陸常用說法，台灣一般只說「公分」；疑似非台灣用語，建議只留「公分」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "公分"（原 "公分；釐米"）；執行長裁示：台灣用語，釐米→公分

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：原文 eight parts 未說等分，譯「八等份」多加了「等」的資訊；英文切蛋糕也較常說 eight pieces（疑似）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "把蛋糕切成八塊。"（原 "把蛋糕切成八等份。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：前文說 each of us carried two liters of water（含弟弟），後文又說弟弟只背了 only a few snacks，前後矛盾。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last weekend, my family went hiking. The path was eight kilometers long. My parents and I each carried two liters of water, and my bag was about five kilograms. My little brother carried the least, only a few snacks. At the top, the view was beautiful. That was my favorite part of the day. A sign there said, \"About one million people visit this mountain every year.\" I also found a small stone of only a few grams."（原 "Last weekend, my family went hiking. The path was eight kilometers long, and each of us carried two liters of water. My bag was about five kilograms. My little brother carried the least, only a few snacks. At the top, we saw a sign: \"This forest is one million years old.\" That was my favorite part of the day. I also found a small stone of only a few grams."）；另一條第②關：森林「一百萬年」不合常理、最喜歡的部分承接牽強。改成每年約一百萬人來爬山；最喜歡的部分改為山頂景色；帶水的人改成作者和爸媽，和弟弟只背零食不再矛盾

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯配合英文修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "上週末，我們全家去健行。步道長八公里。我和爸媽各帶了兩公升的水，我的包包大約五公斤重。我弟弟背得最少，只有幾包零食。山頂的景色很美，那是我一天中最喜歡的部分。那裡的牌子寫著：「每年大約有一百萬人來爬這座山。」我還撿到一顆只有幾公克重的小石頭。"（原 "上週末，我們全家去健行。步道長八公里，每個人都帶了兩公升的水。我的包包大約五公斤重。我弟弟背得最少，只有幾包零食。到了山頂，我們看到一塊牌子寫著：「這片森林已有一百萬年歷史。」那是我一天中最喜歡的部分。我還撿到一顆只有幾公克重的小石頭。"）
